plugin.name: Usage Meter
plugin.description:
Shows the selected model provider's quota, balance, or spend. Recognizes the API URL and reuses the configured key; unsupported URLs are hidden.

Supported providers:
• MiniMax: Shared Token Plan quotas, including five-hour and weekly quotas with separate reset times.
• GLM / Z.ai: Coding Plan five-hour and weekly quota remaining, with API-provided reset times; older plans may also return a separate monthly MCP quota. Recognizes /api/coding/paas/v4 and /api/anthropic on the official China and global hosts, then queries plan availability with the configured API key. The China ordinary /api/paas/v4 endpoint shows CNY available balance, total top-ups, all-time spend, and frozen balance through the console account-report API, using the same key without a console login. Balances exclude resource packages and Coding Plan quotas. The global ordinary endpoint and other paths are hidden.
• DeepSeek: Available, unexpired granted, and topped-up balances, shown separately by currency.
• Moonshot / Kimi: Available, voucher, and cash balances; CNY for China and USD for the global service.
• OpenRouter: Current API key credits and all-time/daily/weekly/monthly spend. No cap does not imply a funded account; account-wide balance requires a management key and is not queried.
• Bailian / Qwen (China): Requires bl and console login. Token Plan keys are matched by their visible prefix/suffix; shows actual quota windows and subscription details. Ordinary keys are matched exactly; shows current-model free quota and this key’s 7-day online usage. Missing CLI, login and account mismatches are shown with installation or login actions.

Compact by default; expand inside the meter or hover for grouped details. The UI checks every minute; queries are cached for 5 minutes. Refresh now bypasses the cache.
